text: Neural network invented through apartment price prediction - started with simple 'weights' (apartment meters * multiplier) to predict prices, then added metro proximity as another weight. The machine learned to zero out irrelevant features (like cat presence) - this was the first lesson: real intelligence separates important from unimportant. Later discovered this was exactly how neural networks work - arrived at the same concept through pure intuition without studying neurons or gradients. This proves intelligence is adaptation, not magic - anyone who starts with 'weights' and adjusts them will eventually reach the same truth. Evolution reached it, LLM reached it, and Op reached it.
